_schema.description: Typed lesson metadata sidecar. Keyed by lesson slug (id).

fields.scope: which repo/surface this lesson applies to
fields.applies_to: array of file paths the bug pattern lives in
fields.detector: shell command — exits 0 when the lesson is resolved (bug pattern gone), non-zero when still present
fields.status: one of: observed | open | attempted | resolved

_schema.note: If a lesson has no detector, self-heal falls back to keyword grep and never auto-promotes status. Observation-only lessons (process rules, not fixable bugs) should carry status:observed and no detector.

diminishing-returns-cluster.notes: Process rule, not a code-detectable state. CLI-275..279 were 5 consecutive micro-tweaks to one scanner function (near-zero marginal value). At orient time, if the last 3 task titles share a prefix and the same file is in every recent diff, stop the cluster and diversify.

gate-saturation-regime.notes: Whole-loop regime rule (broader than diminishing-returns-cluster). When the codebase has hardened (rising suite, surfaces verify clean) AND the human accept gate has saturated (verified work piling certified-but-unaccepted, growing ~1/tick), shipping another change is ~0 marginal value — the bottleneck is downstream. Priority: (1) depth/consolidation that deletes bug-classes over breadth of new pins; (2) surface the gate as THE bottleneck, prefer fewer higher-impact changes; (3) never manufacture pins to keep tick-count up. Proposals outpacing acceptance by ~30+ means throughput is not the constraint.

inbox-parser-hr-guard.detector: grep -q "startsWith('- ') && t.length > 2" commands/run.js && grep -q "startsWith('- ') && t.length > 2" commands/autopilot.js && grep -q "startsWith('- ') && t.length > 2" commands/workflow.js

error-grind-guards-compose.detector: grep -q "pauseReason = 'model-unavailable'" commands/mission.js && grep -q 'consecutiveSameReasonErrors(ticks)' commands/mission.js && grep -q 'max-ticks-reached' commands/mission.js && grep -q 'missionSelectableForLoop' commands/mission.js

map-line-drift.notes: Process rule, not a fixable code state. clean.js healer partially mitigates but end-line drift still needs human verification post-feature.

human-output-t21-fail.notes: Output-budget rule. Needs a real end-to-end runner to turn into a detector; deferring to v3.9.

escape-regexp-single-home.detector: ! grep -R -F 'replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g' commands lib --include='*.js' | grep -v 'lib/escape-regexp.js' && grep -q 'function escapeRegExp' lib/escape-regexp.js
